resources.string: No account needed. Your name is shown by the public verifier next to what you capture. A signing key is created inside this phone\'s secure hardware and never leaves it.
This is your device record. Every capture is signed by this device\'s hardware key and carries this identity in its proof — keep the record if you plan to register the device later.
Need a fresh start? Regenerating gives this device a new id — and a new identity means picking a new display name too.
New captures will carry the new device id and name in their proof. Captures you already took keep the old identity.

TrustCam seals every photo and video at the moment of capture: an invisible watermark in the pixels plus a proof signed by this phone\'s secure hardware, travelling inside the file. Anyone can verify a capture in the browser — no account, no server, nothing uploaded.
The file is watermarked and signed on this device.\nIt will appear in your gallery when done.
